description: Get asylum decisions per year (2000 to the latest year) by country of origin and/or asylum: recognized as refugees, complementary protection, rejected, and otherwise closed, with UNHCR's Refugee Recognition Rate and Total Protection Rate computed over substantive decisions (otherwise-closed cases excluded). By default all decision levels are summed and each row lists the levels it includes; appeal-stage decisions can concern people already decided at first instance, so split_by decision_level or filter decision_levels to FI for first-instance rates. Cases and persons are never added together.

anyOf.description: One code, or several separated by commas or spaces, e.g. "SYR" or "SYR, AFG".
Codes as a list, e.g. ["SYR", "AFG"]; at most 50.

asylum.description: Country of asylum — where people sought or hold protection; for returns, the country they returned from — as ISO3 codes (DEU, TUR), case-insensitive, same rules as origin. At most 50 codes. Omit to sum every asylum country into one row, or set expand to list each.

decision_levels.description: Keep only these decision levels before summing, case-insensitive: NA new applications, FI first instance, AR administrative review, RA repeat/reopened, IN US Citizenship and Immigration Services, EO US Executive Office for Immigration Review, JR judicial review, SP subsidiary protection, FA first instance and appeal, TP temporary protection, TA temporary asylum, BL backlog, TR temporary leave to remain, CA cantonal regulations (Switzerland). ["FI"] gives first-instance decisions. Omit for every level.

expand.description: List every country, one row each, for a dimension that origin or asylum leaves unfiltered: origin, asylum, or both. Default none, where an unfiltered dimension is summed into one row. Expanding a dimension that origin or asylum already filters is rejected.

limit.description: Rows returned inline, 1–500 (default 100). Sorting runs over the full result first; a larger result is staged as a dataframe where dataframes are enabled.

anyOf.description: One code, or several separated by commas or spaces, e.g. "SYR" or "SYR, AFG".
Codes as a list, e.g. ["SYR", "AFG"]; at most 50.

origin.description: Country of origin — where people fled from — as ISO3 codes (SYR, AFG), case-insensitive. ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes (SY) are rewritten to ISO3 and echoed in applied_scope. UNHCR's own codes (GFR) are rejected with the ISO3 to pass instead, and country names are rejected: resolve a name with unhcr_list_reference (topic countries, name_contains). Each listed code returns its own rows; codes are never summed together. At most 50 codes. Omit to sum every origin into one row, or set expand to list each.

sort_by.description: Order of the full result before the inline cut. year (default) orders by year, then origin ISO3, then asylum ISO3; a count field orders largest first, nulls last. Rates are not sortable, since rates on small rounded counts would crowd the top.

split_by.description: Procedure dimensions kept as separate rows: authority (government, UNHCR, or joint) and decision_level (first instance, administrative review, …). Every dimension left out is summed. Default [] sums all authorities and levels, as UNHCR does for its rates. Unit is always kept separate.

items.description: A procedure dimension to keep separate.

stage.description: Stage the full result as a dataframe even when it fits inline, e.g. to join it with another unhcr_get_* result in unhcr_dataframe_query. Where dataframes are unavailable it is ignored, and the notice says so.

year_from.description: First year of the window. When omitted, the window starts at the dataset's first year. A year before the dataset's first year is clamped to it and the clamp is reported; a window entirely outside the dataset's years is rejected.

year_to.description: Last year of the window. When omitted, the window runs to the latest published year (latest_year in the result). A year past the latest published year is clamped to it and the clamp is reported.

name: unhcr_get_asylum_decisions

applied_scope.description: The scope actually sent upstream, including clamped years and code rewrites.

asylum.description: How the asylum dimension was queried.

codes.description: ISO3 codes sent upstream; empty unless mode is listed.

mode.description: summed: every country added into one row; listed: one row per code in codes; each: one row per country (expand).

normalized.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes rewritten to ISO3.

iso3.description: The ISO3 code it was rewritten to.

origin.description: How the origin dimension was queried.

codes.description: ISO3 codes sent upstream; empty unless mode is listed.

mode.description: summed: every country added into one row; listed: one row per code in codes; each: one row per country (expand).

year_from.description: First year sent upstream, after filling and clamping.

year_to.description: Last year sent upstream, after filling and clamping.

attribution.description: Attribution UNHCR requires when these figures are reused.

providers.description: Third-party series in this result (IDMC, UNRWA), whose own conditions may apply.

source.description: Source to cite: "UNHCR Refugee Population Statistics Database".

terms_url.description: URL of UNHCR's Terms of Use for Datasets, to cite with the figures.

complete.description: False when the server row cap stopped the upstream fetch; the notice says how many upstream rows were fetched and how to narrow.

data_notes.description: How to read the counts: stock or flow, rounding, the meaning of null, caveats.

dataset.description: Present when the full result was staged as a dataframe; read its columns with unhcr_dataframe_describe, then query it with unhcr_dataframe_query.

evicted.description: Older dataframes dropped, oldest first, to keep the staged total within the 1,000,000-row budget; they can no longer be queried. Present only when staging this result evicted any.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 time the staged table expires.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_country_code`: An origin or asylum value is not an ISO3 code in UNHCR's country list (after ISO2 normalization). `invalid_year_window`: year_from is later than year_to. `year_out_of_coverage`: The whole requested window lies outside the dataset's published years. `conflicting_scope`: expand names a dimension that origin or asylum already filters. `upstream_busy`: This server's UNHCR request queue cannot start the call's requests before its deadline, or UNHCR answered 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

measure.description: stock: people in a situation on 31 December; flow: events during the year.

notice.description: Guidance for this result: empty-result hints, year clamps, where the full set was staged, or how to narrow.

rows.description: Inline rows, sorted, up to limit.

items.description: One year of decisions for one origin/asylum scope, level split, and unit.

asylum_iso3.description: Country of asylum, ISO3. Null when asylum countries are summed into this row.

asylum_name.description: Asylum country name. Null when summed.

asylum_unhcr_code.description: UNHCR's own code for the asylum country (GFR for Germany), for matching UNHCR publications; origin and asylum take the ISO3 code, not this. Null when summed.

authorities.description: Authority codes summed into this row; a single code when split_by keeps authority separate.

complementary_protection.description: Decisions granting complementary protection instead of refugee status. Null when UNHCR marks it not applicable or not collected — never zero.

decision_levels.description: Decision-level codes summed into this row; a single code when split_by keeps decision level separate.

origin_iso3.description: Country of origin, ISO3. Null when origins are summed into this row.

origin_name.description: Origin country name. Null when summed.

origin_unhcr_code.description: UNHCR's own code for the origin country (GFR for Germany), for matching UNHCR publications; origin and asylum take the ISO3 code, not this. Null when summed.

otherwise_closed.description: Cases closed without a substantive decision, such as withdrawn or abandoned claims. Null when UNHCR marks it not applicable or not collected — never zero.

recognized.description: Decisions granting refugee status. Null when UNHCR marks it not applicable or not collected — never zero.

refugee_recognition_rate.description: Percent on a 0–100 scale, 1 decimal place. Refugee Recognition Rate: recognized ÷ substantive_decisions × 100. Null when substantive_decisions is 0 or null.

rejected.description: Decisions rejecting the claim on its merits. Null when UNHCR marks it not applicable or not collected — never zero.

substantive_decisions.description: recognized + complementary_protection + rejected: the rates’ denominator, null when any of the three is null in any upstream row summed into this row, rather than summed from the rest. Null when UNHCR marks it not applicable or not collected — never zero.

total_decisions.description: Sum of UNHCR’s published decision totals; rounding can set it apart from the four outcomes. Null when UNHCR marks it not applicable or not collected — never zero.

total_protection_rate.description: Percent on a 0–100 scale, 1 decimal place. Total Protection Rate: (recognized + complementary_protection) ÷ substantive_decisions × 100. Null when substantive_decisions is 0 or null.

unit.description: What the counts count: persons, or cases that can cover several people.

total_rows.description: Rows in the full result before the inline cut. When complete is false, the result is built from only the upstream rows fetched before the cap, so rows and summed counts can fall short of the complete result.

truncated.description: True when rows were cut at limit.
